paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: This actual physical tool/device/sensor has +1 appropriate checks and 1 utility charge(s). Before the roll, the actual lead selects this item, directly performs genuinely necessary compatible work for one active minute or throughout a separately allowed shorter task, and spends one charge. Compare it once in equipment.leather-task-enhancement; a stronger eligible source does not refund the spent charge. The original required ordinary tools still apply. Its physical probe/gauge/jaws must actually reach and perform the work; it does not detect hidden creatures through walls. No assistance to creation, repair, re-encoding, recharge or servicing of any bonus-granting advanced/gathering item, including itself or another utility. Actual ordinary engineering, exposed-mechanism investigation, compatible tool tasks and genuine formula research can qualify. Complete positive-HP unsuppressed participating state is required at work and resolution. TI-06 provides actual one-hour trained servicing to reset printed maximum; HP repair, rest and ownership do not.

paragraphs.label: Routed Dissonance
paragraphs.text: Only the acquired TD-08 feature, once per genuine short rest, permits a Bonus Action to route up to two current Dissonance into one own active qualifying device within 30 feet. The routed disabled state prevents movement, attacks, auras, triggers and every other active device use. A routed trap cannot discharge, and a routed utility cannot provide its charged task benefit while disabled. Existing durations and paid service/winding clocks continue. Clearing the disable requires its existing specifically authorized completed removal procedure; it does not refill charges, service, RP or Refrain, erase expenditures, or grant a queued activation. An invalid blocked declaration spends nothing; a later disable does not refund a previously legal committed cost. Actual Field Repair, the existing ten-active-minute/1RP/Tinker's-tools procedure, the origin Tinker's next completed genuine short rest or completed qualifying ordinary repair may clear only the permitted functional state. A buyer's unrelated rest does not clear it.

paragraphs.label: Complete output bodies
paragraphs.text: Choose before any work: TI-tool: Manual driver/probe with indexed contact gauge; one tool, not a full Tinker toolkit. 10 gp, 3 lb, ordinary B5, structural AC 19, dimensions 12 × 4 × 2 inches. See the complete body catalogue for original primaries, constituent masses, hands, capacity and support. A creature output replaces stock object HP/AC with its printed creature statistics. EN alternate weapon/suit hosts use their exact registered existing equipment profile; these default figures do not overwrite that alternate body.

paragraphs.label: Before creation
paragraphs.text: Reserve 7 actual complete never-magically-altered bodies, one model/size per order, in an exclusive fixed order. Pre-roll lawful replacement keeps its ordered position; no post-roll acquisition, substitution or reordering. Transform the first resolved outputs; unused bodies remain actual mundane stock. Record material identity, condition, real storage, actual station capacity, preservation and safe handling; a quoted price supplies none of those facts.

paragraphs.text: Tinkering level 1; INT with actual Tinker's tools training, one PB or replacing expertise, DC 10.
